name: Spencers
observations: Red-brick two-storey end/corner block with yellow Spencers panel across deep blue sign band.
Blue-framed lower doors/window bays include rows of printed display cards.
Upper narrow/tall rectangular windows and plain brick parapet/gable silhouette.
Open yellow-lined vehicle access/car park lies directly alongside, visible in obliques.
A slim lighting column interrupts the sign in detail197.
Preserve open access area rather than extruding the shop row across it.
